summary: Neo spins away and turns, finding himself in an open market teeming with people. He kamikazes his way down the little avenues lined with vendors and shops, careening through the labyrinth out of control. At every turn there is an Agent, appearing from crowds, behind fish counters, tent flaps and crates.
